nodes.title: START HERE — recovered original StudioLight
widgets_values:
# ONE WORKFLOW — START HERE

1. Edit your subject prompt in INPUTS. Original materials stay intact.
2. Choose your preset / Key / Fill / Rim in the original console.
3. Set SPACE: Outside + Dark for this saved night scene; Inside + Dark for a cave.
4. Queue once. Final output is on the far right.

Both passes receive the SAME lighting prompt. Pass 1 runs to completion.

Extra Light = 0 preserves the draft before final refinement. Try 0.15 to test additional subject + wall illumination. It adds light; it does not erase existing shadows or reflections.

Diagnostics below geometry are advisory. Appearance Repair is passthrough; it cannot invent missing faces.

Depth scale and receiver masks are estimates. Optional subject/receiver masks can override them. No sky segmentation or recovered true albedo is claimed.

Defaults are a test starting point, not a GPU-verified visual result.

widgets_values_named.text:
The #1 King Lever: Pass 2 KSampler denoise (Default 0.55)

Determines how much FLUX redraws the image to adopt the new 3D lighting versus locking the Pass 1 geometry.

0.35 – 0.45 (Surgical Polish & Identity Lock):
Result: Strictly preserves original face, pores, and fabric details while adding directional light wrap.

0.50 – 0.60 (The Golden Sweet Spot — Default 0.55):
Result: FLUX generatively synthesizes realistic subsurface scattering on skin, new catchlights in the eyes, and glossy highlights on leather without losing identity.

0.65 – 0.85+ (High Chiaroscuro / Dramatic):
Result: Extreme light transformation (e.g. converting flat draft into moody Film Noir), giving diffusion full creative freedom.
